title: PresetGetReply
description: The parsed form of a preset_get reply (a preset's key and name): one property per word of the reply, a list an array, a record an object, a whole number or a decimal one a number.

load_key.description: The key a preset_load of this preset takes.

name.description: The preset's name: the rest of the line, as the host wrote it, so it may hold spaces and may be empty.
